TextView.android:text: Activates silent distress transmission, continuous telemetry broadcast & auto-encrypted evidence recording.
Paramedic, cardiac arrest, acute physical trauma.
Armed robbery, intrusion, assault, immediate backup.
Stalking, domestic threat, silent hostage alert.
Instantaneous background multi-stream capture ready to record and transmit upon alarm triggering.
Automatic 10-shot burst at 0.2fps with infrared compensation.
Saves previous 30s buffer plus next 10 minutes live stream.
Stereo acoustic noise filter & automatic voice transcription.

Automatic Evidence Protection: Triggering SOS instantly encrypts incoming media via AES-256-GCM and streams tamper-evident cryptographic hashes directly to your decentralized Evidence Vault. Local copies remain invisible to device galleries.
